instructions: The branch has merge conflicts (see `**branch**` above). Check this repository's instructions (such as `AGENTS.md`) for whether to rebase or merge, update the branch from its base that way, and resolve each conflict keeping both sides' changes unless they contradict.
Optional: If you reject a code review suggestion, journal why: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <reason>'`.
Commit any remaining conflict-resolution changes and push to the PR head branch before review mutations.

`$CHANGE_MESSAGE`: one sentence on what changed. Run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_conflict_thread --message "$CHANGE_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
